items.claim: Uros Medic has seven UFC wins, all by knockout, plus another on the Contender Series.
items.quote: Uros Medic who's got seven UFC wins and all seven of those wins are by knockout eight if you include the Contender Series win.

items.claim: Uros Medic is not a first-round-or-bust fighter, having secured later finishes against Matthew Semelsberger and Omar Morales.
items.quote: He's killer be killed, but he is not first round or bust. If he was first round or bust, then why did he knock out Matthew Semlesberger in the third round?

items.claim: Uros Medic is currently in his athletic prime.
items.quote: Medi is flat out in his prime.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez will be the one getting knocked out against Uros Medic due to Medic's pace and ferocity.
items.quote: I think that unfortunately it's going to be D-Rod hitting the deck Saturday night. I think that Medic is going to come after him with a certain ferocity, a certain pace.
